about: What SLATE can do, one capability a row, each held to the code by tools/capabilities.mjs: every command, look, route and file it names must exist. Status is one of Missing, Partial, Implemented, Verified, Blocked, Retired: Verified means every command the row names is run by a test and the outcome checked, not only that code exists; Partial means the capability can’t be fully reached in a student’s life, and limits says why. The four layers are kept apart: a field in the model (schema) is not content, content is not a working interaction, and an interaction is not verified behavior. The rows of the brief of 2026-10-08 (the career, the industry, its database and the rail) are Retired, kept as the record of what was built; the connected world of 2026-10-09 added a row for every capability of the current world, the denominator being those rows, which name all of its commands.

capabilities.goal: Pay part of a card off in a plan, and redeem its rewards
capabilities.entry: Bank, Cards: Make The Plan; Redeem Onto The Card
capabilities.preconditions: A card whose bank charges a plan fee (Chase's, Bank of America's 1.72%); rewards earned
capabilities.effects: Part of the purchase balance paid in equal months for a fixed fee instead of interest; rewards counted at each statement and redeemed onto the card
readers: allocatePayment, which pays a plan's balance last (systems/cash.ts)
capabilities.provenance: The cards' researched terms (content/cards.ts, content/plans.ts)
capabilities.limits: A card's bonus on the bills can't be earned: nothing pays a bill since the reset (docs/UNBITTEN.md). Only Chase and Bank of America offer a plan

capabilities.goal: Lock a card, report it lost or stolen, dispute a charge, and move to a new account number
capabilities.entry: Bank, Cards: Lock It (Unlock It); Report It; Report It, Rush The New One; Give The Bills The New Number; Report It As Not Mine; Move My Account To A New Number
capabilities.preconditions: A card; a charge in the dispute window (disputeRefusal)
capabilities.effects: Locked, nothing new goes on it; reported, it's stopped and a new one arrives on its date, rushed for a fee; a disputed charge refunded by a date, less what the law leaves the holder; a new account number
capabilities.persists: the account's plastic (locked, stopped, last4, arrivesAt, billersStale), the dispute's refund
capabilities.provenance: The banks' own lost-card and dispute terms (content/banks.ts)
capabilities.limits: card.update_billers bites nothing: billersStale declines a recurring charge, and no recurring charge goes on a card since the reset Giving the bills a replaced card’s number (card.update_billers) was retired on 2026-10-09: nothing charges a card as a bill.

capabilities.goal: Enroll in or drop a health plan, buy dental, and deal with care's bills: appeal, apply for aid, pay off the debt
capabilities.entry: Papers, Health Cover: The Marketplace, Enroll or Drop The Plan; A Dental Plan, Buy Dental or Drop Dental; Care And Its Bills, Appeal It, Apply For Assistance, Pay It Off
capabilities.preconditions: mayEnroll (HUSKY D in Connecticut on last month's income, or the marketplace); a denied bill for an appeal; a bill in the charity window for aid; medical debt to pay
capabilities.effects: Cover from the next month; dropped, it ends at the month's end. Yale's dental plan paid for the year at once. An appeal decided after DENIALS.decideDays, overturned or upheld at its published rate. Connecticut's charity care makes a bill free or discounted by income. An unpaid bill becomes medical debt, paid down from the current account
capabilities.persists: HealthRecord.program, marketplace, dental, bills, debtSince; the medical debt account
readers: coverOn and planOf for every bill (systems/health.ts)
capabilities.provenance: Connecticut's Medicaid and charity-care rules, plans' denial and appeal rates, Yale Health's dental plan (content/safetynet.ts)
capabilities.limits: health.drop and health.pay_bill have no test. The union plans and COBRA after one can't be reached without the career (docs/UNBITTEN.md)

capabilities.goal: Choose your doctor and pharmacy, and book or call off an appointment
capabilities.entry: Papers, Health Cover: Your Doctor: Your Doctor, Your Pharmacy, Call It Off, Book An Appointment
capabilities.preconditions: A practice where you live; a pharmacy's cash price only in America; a visit owed for booking
capabilities.effects: A need becomes an appointment after the place's published wait, on a weekday morning, on the calendar. Kept, it's the visit, billed by the cover, and it may refer to a specialist; missed or called off, the need waits to be booked again. A generic is filled at the chosen pharmacy's cash price
capabilities.provenance: Real practices and prices (content/clinics.ts); waits and referral rates from AMN, NAMCS 2019 (content/appointments.ts)
capabilities.limits: What a specialist finds isn't kept: SLATE's conditions don't name one

capabilities.goal: Keep a chronic condition treated, fill a longer supply, prepay prescriptions, and begin a course of therapy
capabilities.entry: Papers, Health Cover: Your Conditions, Keep It Up or Let It Go, Fill A Longer Supply, N Days, Begin A Course Of 8; Your Doctor, Prepay Three Months, Prepay A Year
capabilities.preconditions: A chronic condition; a treated one for a longer supply; living in England for a prepayment certificate; depression and a therapist where you live for therapy
capabilities.effects: Treated, the medicine is filled at the pharmacy where you live with a week left, and the condition is kept up; a longer supply filled and paid at once; a prepayment makes English prescriptions free while it runs; therapy is eight weekly sessions at the practice's price, and the course lifts depression at the published rate
readers: fillMedicine and the condition's monthly effect (systems/health.ts)
the therapy session handler and therapyLifts (systems/therapy.ts)
capabilities.provenance: NHS prescription charges; NICE NG222 and NHS Talking Therapies' recovery rate; named practices' prices (systems/therapy.ts)
capabilities.limits: Treatment is reachable and tested. health.extra_supply and health.prepay have no test Therapy in New Haven is Yale Mental Health & Counseling’s from 2026-10-09, free to a student Yale Health covers (tests/therapy.test.ts); until then no therapist practised there.

capabilities.goal: Say you use a wheelchair, and apply for a disability parking permit
capabilities.entry: Papers, Health Cover: Getting About: I Use A Wheelchair (I Don't Use A Wheelchair); Apply For A Disability Placard, Fee Not Published
capabilities.preconditions: A wheelchair user for the permit, where the place issues one
capabilities.effects: The wheelchair is noted; New Haven's placard is issued without a charge, its fee not published
readers: permitRefusal (systems/access.ts) and the Getting About panel, nothing else
capabilities.provenance: research-access-availability.json
capabilities.limits: Retired on 2026-10-09 (systems/access.ts deleted): a wheelchair said and a parking permit were read only by the hotels and the meters, which went in the scope reset. What a wheelchair changes in a student’s life (step-free rooms, the school’s accommodations) isn’t kept.

capabilities.goal: Apply for or renew a passport, get a state ID card or REAL ID, and report, police-report and replace a lost document
capabilities.entry: Papers, Passport And ID: Your Passport, Apply For One (Renew It), Apply Faster (Renew It Faster); a document's Report Lost, Report Stolen, File A Police Report, Replace It; Your ID, Get <Card>, Make It REAL ID
capabilities.preconditions: passportRefusal (the issuer's rule, no application pending); an ID card where SLATE issues one; REAL ID on a license the state upgrades before renewal (Connecticut's); a lost document for a report
capabilities.effects: A passport paid for and issued after the issuer's time, faster for a fee; the old one canceled with any authorization on it. Reported lost, a document is canceled. An ID card or REAL ID upgrade paid at the state's fee. A replacement after its time
capabilities.persists: Person.documents (status, issuedAt, expiresAt, policeReport, realId), the fees' ledger postings
readers: visaRefusal and authorizationRefusal, which read the passport's citizenship (systems/documents.ts)
tsaAccepts, read only by the document look's sentence (systems/identity.ts)
capabilities.provenance: Each issuer's published fees and times (content/documents.ts, content/identity.ts)
capabilities.limits: documents.apply_idcard, documents.police_report and documents.real_id have no test. REAL ID was for a flight's checkpoint and a police report is read only by its own refusal: both bite nothing since travel went. documents.test.ts reloads only an old save given papers

capabilities.goal: Apply for a visa or a travel authorization for another country
capabilities.entry: Papers, Passport And ID: Going Abroad: choose a country, Apply For The Authorization, Apply For The Visa
capabilities.preconditions: A rule SLATE keeps for the citizenship and the destination (visaRefusal, authorizationRefusal); a passport in force
capabilities.effects: Paid for and decided by a date; a US visa's consulate interview is booked on the calendar and must be kept, a no-show closing the application with the fee kept (systems/papervisits.ts)
capabilities.persists: Person.documents (the visa or authorization, pending then valid), the visit's calendar item
capabilities.provenance: Each country's rules (content/visas.ts); research-appointments-immigration.json
capabilities.limits: A visa or authorization issued is read by nothing that crosses a border: crossingRefusal has no caller since travel went in the reset

capabilities.goal: Apply for OPT, permission to work in the US after the degree
capabilities.entry: Papers, Permission To Work: OPT, Apply For OPT, Apply With Premium Processing. Home: Apply For OPT on the US status decision
capabilities.preconditions: On an F-1, from 90 days before the program ends (optRefusal)
capabilities.effects: Paid for and decided after SLATE's processing time, faster with premium; in force, it keeps the US status from ending, and each week counts days without work
readers: usPermits and the US status handler (systems/permission.ts)
capabilities.provenance: USCIS's form and fees; processing time SLATE's estimate (content/permission.ts)
capabilities.limits: There is no work after the degree since the career went, so OPT's idle days always pass the limit: it ends, and the status with it, with no grace. Whether that should be so is the owner's open call on a life's income after school

capabilities.goal: Apply for residence in another country, renew it, settle, and naturalize
capabilities.entry: Papers, Permission To Work: Residence Abroad: Apply, Renew, Settle, Naturalize
capabilities.preconditions: routeRefusal: Mexico's temporary residence, on savings or six months' income; four years' temporary to settle; five years' residence in Mexico to naturalize there
capabilities.effects: Mexico's temporary residence for a year, paid with its consular visa; renewed yearly; permanent after four years; citizenship applied for, paid and decided after its days
capabilities.provenance: Mexico's INM requirements and fees (MEXICAN_RESIDENCE, NATURALIZE)
capabilities.limits: Only Mexico's route is open: Britain's Global Talent and the green card read a career's record, Canada and Ireland have no route. Residence is granted without living there, and nothing reads it as a place to live. documents.settle and documents.naturalize have no test

capabilities.goal: Claim unemployment, apply for assistance, and register for Canada's EI
capabilities.entry: Papers, Unemployment: File A Claim; SNAP, Apply; EI Special Benefits, Register
capabilities.preconditions: A Connecticut claim on base-period wages (basePeriodFor); SNAP for a citizen under its income line (assistanceRefusal); EI for someone living in Canada
capabilities.effects: A claim pays its weekly benefit each certified week for up to a year, Connecticut's with no waiting week; SNAP pays monthly onto an EBT card, spent on the day's food first
capabilities.provenance: Connecticut, New York and California UI rules; USDA SNAP (content/safetynet.ts)
capabilities.limits: Every life lives in New Haven, so Universal Credit, Jobseeker's Allowance, Mexico City's insurance and EI are out of reach, and EI's panel never shows. Whether a student's wages ever meet Connecticut's base period wasn't measured. A week worked while claiming reads nought (docs/UNBITTEN.md). SNAP is kept for a citizen only

capabilities.goal: Claim a state pension on a contribution record
capabilities.entry: Papers, Unemployment: Claim Social Security; State Pension, Claim It; State Pension (Ireland), Claim It; IMSS Pension, Claim It; Pension Para El Bienestar, Claim It
capabilities.preconditions: Social Security: 40 credits and 62; the UK's: ten qualifying years and its age; Ireland's: its paid contributions and 66; IMSS: its weeks; Bienestar: a Mexican living in Mexico from 65
capabilities.effects: A pension paid on its schedule into the bank for life
readers: each pension's payment handler (systems/socialsecurity.ts, statepension.ts, homepensions.ts, imss.ts)
capabilities.provenance: SSA, gov.uk, gov.ie, IMSS and Bienestar rules for 2026
capabilities.limits: No life reaches any of them: a student's wages make a few credits at most and nothing is earned after the degree, no life works in Britain, Ireland or Mexico, and none lives in Mexico.

capabilities.goal: File each year's tax return and pay what's owed
capabilities.entry: Papers, Tax Returns: File It, Pay What's Owed. Home: File It on the return's decision
capabilities.preconditions: A year's return prepared from the earnings record; owed for paying
capabilities.effects: Filed, a refund arrives 21 days on or a balance is paid from the bank, or owed until it is; after 15 April with a balance, the late penalties are added, and a balance left owing grows by the IRS's interest
capabilities.persists: Person.returns by year (figures, filed, paid), the ledger postings
capabilities.provenance: IRS rules: its interest and late penalties, the performing artist deduction; the state's tax where they last lived (content/safetynet.ts RETURN)
capabilities.limits: The return's own header comment in systems/taxreturn.ts still names a home's rent and a sale's gain (systems/homes.ts), which went in the reset
